layouts.name: Autodrom Sosnova
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Earlier asphalt configuration follows the straight northern side, inner northeastern loop and full southern and southwestern bends. Northern zigzag alternatives and the eastern inner-loop shortcut are excluded. Independent source length 1063.8 m is preserved against the documented 1075 m configuration; this does not claim the later enlarged circuit. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1063.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
